usage: agentbreeder next [-h] [--environment ENVIRONMENT] [--output OUTPUT]
                         [--json]
                         [DIR]

positional arguments:
  DIR                   Project directory with agent.yaml and stack.yaml
                        (default: .)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --environment ENVIRONMENT
                        Environment (default: dev)
  --output OUTPUT       Where `build --output` wrote its manifests (default
                        DIR/deploy)
  --json                Print the checklist as JSON
